A dream is a pass over finished work: sessions that have ended, the friction
box, handoff docs, memory directories, and the commits in the repos those
sessions ran in. A Claude agent, dream-<id>, reads them and writes back only
through agent dream's own verbs: it consolidates memory, triages friction
(duplicates, links, accepting what is clearly real; it never resolves an
entry as fixed), and keeps a diary.

Dreaming is opt-in by directory: only sessions run in a directory of the
dream scope (or below one) are reviewed, with their memory and commits;
the friction box is the host's whatever the scope. The first dream looks
back 7 days, and nothing older is ever taken unless it is written to again.

People (or a timer) run these:

  scope    choose the directories dreaming covers (add, remove, list)
  gather   what the next dream would review, without starting one
  run      start a dream: gather, record it, write its digest, spawn its agent
  list     the dreams so far
  show     one dream: its diary and what it was given

The dream agent runs these, on its own open dream only:

  note, commit, abandon, friction dup|link|accept, limitation,
  memory put|remove (memory get and check only read)

An item counts as reviewed once its dream commits, at the version it had
then: a session written to again or a friction entry voted on comes back.
A dream that is abandoned, or whose agent goes away, leaves its items for
the next one. With nothing new, a dream is recorded as quiet and no agent
starts, until the last committed dream is 7 days old.

Usage:
  agent dream [flags]
  agent dream [command]

Examples:
  agent dream scope add ~/src/app
  agent dream gather
  agent dream run --dry-run
  agent dream run
  agent dream list
  agent dream show 3

Available Commands:
  scope       Choose the project directories dreaming covers
  gather      List what the next dream would review, without starting one
  run         Start a dream: gather, record it, and spawn its agent
  list        List the dreams so far
  show        Show a dream: its diary and what it was given
  note        Add a line to your dream's diary
  commit      Finish your dream: what it was given counts as reviewed
  abandon     Give up your dream: its items wait for the next one
  friction    Triage friction for your dream: duplicates, links, accepting
  limitation  File friction about dreaming itself
  memory      Read, write and check a memory directory, under a dream's guard

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for dream

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent dream [command] --help" for more information about a command.
